Add Account

Paste a row from Google Ads (tab or space separated).
Example: 5,966.26 1,773 3.37 196 30.48
Order: Cost · Clicks · Avg CPC · Conv · Cost/Conv
Detected Values

Account health is calculated automatically from Cost/Conv vs your targets in Settings.

Avg CPC and Cost/Conv will be computed automatically if left blank.

Goals (optional) Set per-account targets to enable pacing & smarter health scoring

Leave any field blank to skip that goal. Target CPA, when set, overrides the global threshold for this account only.

Google Ads link Customer ID enables the "Open in Google Ads" button

Find this at the top of your Google Ads account, next to the account name. Hyphens optional.

Health Targets

Set your Cost/Conversion thresholds. Accounts are automatically scored based on these values.

Today's Focus thresholds Used in the Wins and Needs Attention columns

Wins: accounts hitting both CTR and Cost/Conv targets. Needs Attention: accounts where W/W cost-per-conv exceeds your concern threshold AND CTR drops below the win level.
